annotations.title: Find public records by address or reference

description: Find public records by title/address text, postcode or public UUID. Exact and lexical lookup uses no model or embeddings; supports token prefixes and bounded typo tolerance in accepted search publications. Returns separate families with UUID detail links and explicit searched coverage. Never claim an unlisted family was searched, or that no match proves nonexistence. For full address matching use address_autocomplete; for a UPRN use address_by_uprn. For attribute criteria use search_entities with the governed query. Free.
name: lookup_entities
